Jamie Raskin will be there, front and center.
How high is your level of confidence that this will be a fair ballot and there will

every election, particularly the ones he's lost, contesting as a mild word for it, what's

So much of the Machiavelli and manipulation of our elections takes place long before election

in terms of the congressional delegation. Why is that? Well, it's very simple. It's because
the Republicans have been gerrymandering themselves into power in the state legislature for decades,
and by doing that, they are then able to gerrymander the U.S. House delegation as well.
So when you say, well, it would be a fair ballot, no, it's definitely not a fair ballot.
The Republicans swear by gerrymandering.
We've, the Democrats have tried in the Democracy for All Act, in the For the People Act, the
Fair Redistricting Act. We've tried multiple times to mandate independent,
nonpartisan redistricting commissions in every state and union.
Every Democrat has voted for it and every Republican opposes it.
And then Trump created this mid-decade gerrymander, extreme gerrymander in Texas in order to squeeze

place, no, it has not been fair balloting.
Nonetheless, we accept the rules as they are, and we are fighting to win within those rules.
Let's say you win at a minimum the House of Representatives.
What maneuver, what form of rhetoric, what form of action do you fear the most and seem

selection officials in charge will somehow try not to grant the certificates of election

So that's the kind of thing that we're ready for.
I mean, we remember when Donald Trump called up Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger in

the whole country saw it, and we know that they have been trying to replace the Brad

We impeach Donald Trump twice. He has 50% of all the presidential impeachments in American history, right?
We understand that it is a political device that's been put into the Constitution by the framers, and it's been put into the political branches.
They literally debated whether or not the trial for high crimes and misdemeanors should take place in the Supreme Court.
And they decided no, it belongs in the political branches.
So what does that mean?
When Democrats say, well, should we start off in impeaching Donald Trump for his palpable transgressions against the Constitution?
Or should we start off by getting everybody their Medicaid back and the ACA tax credits back and getting everybody that we can, their healthcare,

the destruction of SNAP benefits. We got to get those people back on SNAP benefits.

Well, is that fair?

Not that it doesn't care, but in terms of...
Corruption and transgression.
The public cares deeply about...
Not that it doesn't care, but it's a matter of priority in the public mind.
That's absolutely right.

We're not afraid of impeachment, and we're not even afraid of a trial in the Senate,

Republican Party.
You know, Liz Cheney is gone.
Adam Kinziger is gone.

look at all those different questions. It is a tool in the toolbox just like censure is there,

So let's not make a fetish out of impeachment. Let's not make a taboo out of impeachment.
